project.name: Gimle Saga
project.description: The test-report server: a standalone local process (SagaMain) that ingests SagaEvent NDJSON streams shipped by test runs (or folded in after the fact from Surefire XML), stores each run as an append-only event file plus derived metadata, maintains a flake ledger across runs, and serves the whole record -- runs, live event tails, flaky-test scoreboard, per-test history -- over a small JSON HTTP API with the bundled gimle-saga-console SPA at /console. A development tool, deliberately unauthenticated and loopback-bound by default, never part of a deployed Gimle cluster's own process topology.
